Browser simulator dependencies (served locally; no external runtime requests)

Pyodide 0.26.4: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide (Mozilla Public License 2.0; PYODIDE-LICENSE.txt)
Python 3.12: https://www.python.org (PSF license; PYTHON-LICENSE.txt)
Pymunk 6.11.1 / Chipmunk2D: https://github.com/viblo/pymunk (MIT license; PYMUNK-LICENSE.txt)
NumPy 1.26.4: https://numpy.org (BSD license; NUMPY-LICENSE.txt)
CFFI 1.16.0 and pycparser 2.22: wheel license files included alongside this notice.
IBM Plex Sans (400, 600, 700), IBM Plex Serif Regular, and IBM Plex Mono Regular: https://github.com/IBM/plex (SIL Open Font License; FONT-LICENSE.txt)

Pyodide runtime sources: https://github.com/pyodide/pyodide/tree/0.26.4
Runtime binaries: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/pyodide/v0.26.4/full/
Pymunk WebAssembly binary: https://github.com/viblo/pymunk/releases/tag/6.11.1
No changes were made to the distributed simulator dependency binaries.
IBM Plex Sans and Serif WOFF2 files are lossless webfont encodings of the retained TTF files; glyphs and metrics are unchanged.
